scientific_integrity: One final structural theorem and its complete finite relocation geometry. Proof incorporates a reproducible exhaustive orbit check and independently implemented propagation and structure checkers; the review is not independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact result only for the simple four-cube Q4, a single sensor failure, and pairwise distinct initial sensor locations. Jump/slide relocation allows only four-sensor robust configurations; higher cube dimensions and larger failures are unproved. The 2010 grid paper was compared from its metadata and abstract, not its complete primary text; remaining unindexed-priority risk is disclosed.
title: One-failure power domination of the four-cube: five optimal geometries and a relocation divide
